description:
Find Instagram reels for a keyword through search-engine results, then open each reel for its owner, caption, likes, comments, views, duration, audio, cover image and MP4 link.
Cost: 3 credits per successful call (failed calls are refunded).
Returns: query (string), date_posted (string, nullable), page (integer), reels (array<object>), reels_found (integer), reels_fetched (integer), has_more (boolean).

date_posted.description: Only reels the search engine dates within this window: last-week, last-month or last-year. Omit for any time. Example: "last-month"

limit.description: How many of the page's reels to open for full details. Example: 10

page.description: Search results page, about 10 reels per page. Values outside 1-10 are rejected. Example: 1

query.description: Keyword or phrase to search for, 1-100 characters. site: and !bang operators are ignored. Example: "dogs"

name: instagram_reels_search
title: Instagram reels search
